HMPV New Virus 🦠(Human Metapneumovirus)

Measures to prevent the virus :- 

1 - Wash your hands frequently with soap and water for at least 20 seconds or alcohol based sanitizer 

2 - Avoid close contact with people who are sick

#HMPVinInd
